interface.name: caminito_dock_activation_manager_v1

description.summary: be told which Dock item to activate

interface.description:
On Wayland a panel applet can't grab keys, so the compositor binds the keys that activate a Dock item, and tells a Dock applet which item the user asked for. Each Dock applet makes one object for the surface of the panel it is in. The compositor tells one of them, chosen by the output that surface is on.
This is a private protocol of Caminito's. A client that finds no global does nothing, and the compositor binds no keys for it.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager. Objects it made are not affected.

request.name: get_dock_activation

description.summary: be told which Dock item to activate

request.description: Makes the object a Dock applet is told through. The surface is the panel's, the layer surface the applet is drawn in; the compositor reads its output each time it chooses an applet, so a panel that moves goes with it. One client can make several objects, one for each Dock applet it has.

interface.name: caminito_dock_activation_v1

description.summary: a Dock applet the compositor tells which item to activate

interface.description: While the object exists, the compositor can send it activate.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The applet is told nothing more. It is not chosen in place of another.

event.name: activate
event.description: The user asked for the Dock item at index, counted from 0 in the order the applet shows its Dock items. What the activation does is the applet's. An index past its last Dock item does nothing.
